objective: Reconcile the independent Jules outputs into one authoritative master-based lineage.
decisions: master is the canonical integration branch because it is the repository default and contains the newer benchmark and repository history.
PR #30 is duplicate Sentry coordination state and is not retained as a separate lineage.
PR #27 and PR #28 were based on stale main and their useful changes are selectively re-applied to master.
PR #29 is too broad and stale to merge as a snapshot; only its verified repository-health changes are retained.
One authoritative cycle state and one handoff lineage are maintained.
